collectionMemo.title: Collection memo

collectionMemo.target.label: Collection target
collectionMemo.range.localTime: Enter times in your local time zone. Records are also displayed in local time.
collectionMemo.range.pointHint: Use the same start and end time to record a single collected point.
collectionMemo.range.empty: No collected ranges recorded for this target.
collectionMemo.timeline.label: Collection timeline for {{name}}
collectionMemo.confirm.deleteTarget: Delete “{{name}}” and all its collected ranges?
collectionMemo.validation.name: Enter a collection target name of 1 to 200 characters.
collectionMemo.validation.date: Enter valid start and end dates and times.
collectionMemo.validation.order: The end must be at or after the start.
collectionMemo.validation.future: Collected dates and times cannot be in the future.
collectionMemo.error.load: Could not load collection memos. Refresh to try again.
collectionMemo.error.save: Could not save your changes. Check the details and try again.
collectionMemo.empty: Add a collection target to start recording your collected ranges.
collectionMemo.noResults: No collection targets match your search.
